journey.eiHeading: Apply for EI and keep up with reporting

jobSearch.title: Search and apply for jobs on Job Bank
jobSearch.body: Browse job postings that match your skills and apply directly through Job Bank.

eiApply.title: Apply for Employment Insurance
eiApply.body: Apply for EI benefits online as soon as you stop working — even if you don't have your ROE yet, applying right away avoids delaying your first payment.

eiReport.title: Submit your EI report every two weeks
eiReport.body: Once your claim is active, complete your EI report every two weeks — even if you have no income to report — or your payments will stop.

departure.heading: Steps to take when you leave your job

roe.title: Get your Record of Employment (ROE)
roe.body: Ask your employer for your ROE — you'll need it to apply for Employment Insurance. Employers must issue it within 5 days of your last day worked.

finalPay.title: Confirm your final pay and vacation pay
finalPay.body: Check that your final pay includes all wages owed and any unused vacation pay, per your province or territory’s employment standards.

benefitsContinuation.title: Ask about continuing your workplace benefits
benefitsContinuation.body: Find out whether you can convert your health, dental, or life insurance to an individual policy, and for how long your current coverage lasts.

returnProperty.title: Return company property
returnProperty.body: Return any laptop, ID badge, keys, or uniforms, and get written confirmation that they were received.

reference.title: Ask for a letter of reference
reference.body: Request a reference letter or confirmation of employment while your manager's memory is fresh — you'll likely need it for job applications.

keepRecords.title: Keep records for your EI application
keepRecords.body: Keep your ROE, pay stubs, and dates of employment on hand — you'll need this information to apply for EI.

updateCv.title: Update your résumé and LinkedIn profile
updateCv.body: Add your most recent role, accomplishments, and skills.

training.title: Look into training and upskilling
training.body: Look for government-funded training programs or certifications that could improve your job prospects.

benefits.heading: Benefits you might now be eligible for

taxCredits.title: GST/HST credit and other income-tested benefits
taxCredits.body: A lower income this year could change what you receive from the GST/HST credit or other income-tested benefits when you file your next tax return.

provincial.title: Provincial or territorial supports
provincial.body: Check whether your province or territory offers additional income or health-coverage support during unemployment.

firstSteps.heading: Steps to take after your baby is born

registerBirth.title: Register the birth
registerBirth.body: Register your baby’s birth with your province or territory — most also let you apply for a birth certificate and the Canada Child Benefit at the same time.

sinApplication.title: Apply for your baby’s Social Insurance Number
sinApplication.body: Many provinces let you apply for a SIN as part of birth registration; otherwise apply separately once you have the birth certificate.

eiMaternityParental.title: Apply for EI maternity and parental benefits
eiMaternityParental.body: Apply as soon as you stop working — you can apply for maternity benefits before the birth and parental benefits after.

cdcp.title: Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP)
cdcp.description: Losing job-related dental coverage may make you newly eligible for the CDCP — check your dashboard for a personalized look at your benefits.

canadaChildBenefit.title: Canada Child Benefit (CCB)
canadaChildBenefit.description: A tax-free monthly payment to help with the cost of raising children under 18.

provincialFamilySupports.title: Provincial or territorial family supports
provincialFamilySupports.description: Check whether your province or territory offers additional parental leave top-ups or family benefits.

cdcp.title: Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP)
cdcp.description: You may be eligible for the CDCP — check your dashboard for a personalized look at your benefits.

disabilityTaxCredit.title: Disability Tax Credit (DTC)
disabilityTaxCredit.description: A non-refundable tax credit that reduces the income tax you may have to pay.
